Game 1 of 2 begins: every seat has its full dice again. Your points from all games add up to your score. The game: liar's dice for 2 seats. Every seat starts with 5 dice of 6 faces. Each round every seat still in rolls its dice in secret: you see only your own dice, and everyone sees how many dice each seat has. The seat that opens the round makes a bid about all dice on the table, for example "5 x 4": at least five dice on the whole table show a 4. Then, in table order, each seat either bids higher (more dice, or as many dice on a higher face) or calls the last bid a lie (liar). Ones are wild: a 1 counts for every face, and nobody may bid on ones. Faces from 2 to 6 can be bid on. A liar call shows every die: if the table holds at least the bid's quantity of its face, the bid held and the caller loses one die; otherwise the bidder loses one die. The seat that lost a die opens the next round. A seat with no dice is out; the last seat with dice wins the game. Points per game by place: first 1, second 0. There is no table talk.
Round 1: new roll; dice per seat A01 (you) 5, A02 5; A01 (you) opens.

Your turn (round 1). Your dice: 1 2 5 6 6. Dice on the table: 10. The standing bid: none yet (you open). You may open the round with any bid (bid quantity and face, faces 2-6, at most 10 dice). Act with bid (quantity, face) or liar, each with a short reason that nobody else sees.

timeline.reply: You bid 1 x 2. A02 is to act, not you: end your turn now; you will be told when it is yours.
